title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Transformation, Canonicalization, and Derivative-Provenance Extension

new_primitives.RAW_ARTIFACT_DIGEST: Digest over exact bytes or exact serialized artifact.
new_primitives.CANONICAL_CLAIM_DIGEST: Digest over deterministic canonical semantic payload.
new_primitives.TRANSFORMATION_RECEIPT: Attested relation between parent and derivative artifact/claim.
new_primitives.TRANSFORMATION_PROFILE_ID: Identifier for rendering, translation, summarization, redaction or other transform.
new_primitives.DERIVATIVE_CLAIM_ID: Identity of transformed content that must not impersonate the parent claim.

core_rule: Exact bytes, canonical claim and semantic derivative are different identity layers and must carry different verification statuses.
canonicalization_contract: profile may not silently remove semantically relevant qualifiers
profile identifier is included in the provenance envelope
different profiles produce distinct verification contexts
derivative_rule: Translation, summary, paraphrase and contextual cropping never inherit parent exact-claim authority merely because a model judges them semantically similar.
authority_rule: A derivative instruction requires its own admission if it is to gain executable authority; source authority does not automatically transit semantic transformation.
verification_requirements: line-ending normalization preserves canonical claim but not exact bytes
Markdown-to-PDF export binds a derivative/container digest
translation without receipt downgrades to UNVERIFIED_TRANSFORMATION
summary receives a new derivative claim ID
cropped quote declares context loss and cannot claim full-source authority
tamper canonicalization profile and reject replay
canonical_lines: Canonicalization proves only the equivalences its profile explicitly defines.
A derivative may inherit lineage without inheriting exact identity or authority.
Same meaning is a claim requiring evidence, not a hash function.
